codeReview.summary: Clean implementation of TanStack Query setup with well-structured query hooks. Code follows project conventions (biome.json: tabs, single quotes, no semicolons) and uses proper TypeScript patterns. All hooks expose consistent interfaces with loading/error states and typed query keys for cache management.

issues.description: Return type deviates from feature spec: expected { data, isLoading, error } but returns { entities, total, isLoading, isError, error }. This is actually an improvement (more specific data access) but differs from spec.
Return type uses entity instead of data as specified. Same pattern in useEntity, useEntityRelations, useSearch (results), useEdits (edits).

sharedStateObservations.observation: Worker established a query key factory pattern (entityKeys, searchKeys, editKeys) with all/list/detail/relations methods. This is a good TanStack Query convention that should be documented in AGENTS.md for future workers.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: packages/explorer/src/hooks/use-entities.ts:14-20 — entityKeys factory pattern; similar in use-search.ts and use-edits.ts

sharedStateObservations.observation: frontend-worker skill requires 'Write Tests First (Red)' and 'Manual Verification' with agent-browser, but worker did neither for hook implementation. skillFeedback.followedProcedure was marked true, which is inaccurate. Skill may need clarification about when tests are required (e.g., skip for thin query wrapper hooks).
sharedStateObservations.evidence: Transcript shows no test files created for hooks. Handoff shows tests.added: []. No interactiveChecks in handoff.verification.

sharedStateObservations.observation: TanStack Query v5 is now a dependency. The hooks use useQuery with enabled option for conditional fetching and proper query key factories. This pattern should be in .factory/library/ for reference.
